name: Oshino (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Oshino village emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised mountain with a character.
history: Municipal flag of Oshino, a village in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 17 December 1970.

features.role: Oshino village emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised mountain with a character
